run_denoise_and_vad_cli: run the CLI tool to denoise audio files and apply voice activity detection from a manifest
run_process_audio_manifest: run the process function to denoise and apply VAD to audio files listed in a TSV manifest
run_apply_vad: run the apply_vad function to detect voice segments and remove silence from an audio file
run_convert_sr: run the convert_sr function to resample an audio file to a target sample rate using sox
run_write_audio: run the write function to save a normalized audio tensor as a 16-bit PCM WAV file
